auto_download.description: Auto-download (catch-up and on arrival) for a pending, non-expired file. phone: picker is the picker for the current network ("On Wi-Fi" or "On mobile data"); Data Saver / Low Data Mode on mobile = Off. browser: one picker, network ignored. cli (listen --files DIR): every file up to MAX_FILE, no picker. picker is the limit in bytes (0 = Off); download = picker > 0 and size <= picker. Assert download for each row.

blob.description: AES-256-GCM, one random 32-byte key and one random 12-byte nonce per file, no AAD, one tag, never chunked. blob = nonce (12) || ciphertext || tag (16); blob_size = size + 28 exactly. key is the 43-char b64url file.key. sha256 is the 43-char b64url SHA-256 of the whole blob (file.sha256 and the PA-File-SHA256 header). Assert: seal(key, nonce, plaintext) == blob; open(key, blob) == plaintext; sha256(blob) == sha256; a blob with any bit flipped fails to open.

collision.description: CLI listen --files DIR: when the sanitized name exists in DIR, use "base (N).ext" with the smallest N >= 1 that is free; names match ignoring case (ASCII, as names are sanitized); base and ext split as names step 5 (no ext -> "base (N)"). existing = names already in DIR. Assert collide(name, existing) == output.

constants.description: MAX_FILE = largest plaintext size in bytes; BLOB_OVERHEAD = blob bytes beyond the plaintext (nonce 12 + tag 16). Content-Length limit = MAX_FILE + BLOB_OVERHEAD.

description: PushArmor file send vectors v1 (normative). Binary values are strict b64url unless a field says hex. Sizes are bytes (decimal), times are unix seconds, PA-Time is unix ms. Sections marked worker_only (ttl, key) are for the Worker; clients never hardcode a lifetime.

download_sig.description:
PA-DL1 signing string for a GET on the file host, frozen, UTF-8, no trailing newline: "PA-DL1
GET
" + path + "
" + PA-Time, where path is the URL pathname with its leading "/". The Range header is not signed; each request (each retry and each resumed Range request) gets a fresh PA-Time and PA-Sig. Headers: PA-ID, PA-Time, PA-Sign-Pub and PA-Enc-Pub (87-char b64url raw points of the signing device), PA-Sig (86-char b64url raw r||s, ECDSA P-256 SHA-256, as PA-REQ1). Signer X from golden-v1.json keys.peers; the url is a file of the account of X. Assert signed_bytes byte for byte from path and pa_time, path equals the url pathname, every header from the fields, and that sig verifies with sign_pub (verify only) exactly when verifies is true; a false row has a changed PA-Sig and must be refused.

file_sig.description:
PA-FILE1 signing strings, frozen, UTF-8, no trailing newline. POST: "PA-FILE1
POST
/v1/file
" + PA-Time + "
" + Content-Length (decimal) + "
" + PA-File-SHA256 + "
" + PA-Send-ID. DELETE: "PA-FILE1
DELETE
/v1/file/" + id + "
" + PA-Time (no body line). PA-Sig = b64url of raw r||s, ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 over the string, as PA-REQ1. Signer X from golden-v1.json keys.peers. Assert signed_bytes byte for byte from the fields and that sig verifies with sign_pub (verify only) exactly when verifies is true; a false row has a changed PA-Sig and must be refused.

key.description: WORKER ONLY (clients use url and id as received). expires = accept_time + ttl_min * 60 (unix seconds); minute = UTC YYYYMMDDHHMM of floor(expires / 60); acct_hash = first 16 lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(acct_secret, raw account id bytes); id = minute + "-" + rand_hex (32 lowercase hex of 16 random bytes); key = "v1/" + minute + "/" + acct_hash + "/" + id; url = "https://b2file.pusharmor.com/" + key. Assert every output from the inputs.

names.description: File names, applied by sender and receiver. Steps: 1 basename (split on "/" and "\\"); 2 every char (code point) outside [A-Za-z0-9 ._()-] -> "_"; 3 collapse runs of "_" to one "_" and runs of spaces to one space; 4 trim leading and trailing dots and spaces; 5 extension = text after the last dot if 1-10 chars of [A-Za-z0-9], else none (base = all); 6 fallback base if the base has no [A-Za-z0-9] or is > 64 chars: "file-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS" (or "image-..." when image is true) from time in UTC, extension kept; 7 cut so the total is <= 100 (guard); 8 if the text before the first dot, without trailing spaces and dots, equals CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9 or LPT1-LPT9 (any case), prefix "_". Digits-only names are kept. Code points are not normalized (an NFD name keeps its combining marks as "_"). image and time are inputs (the caller decides image; time is send or receive time). Assert sanitize(input, time, image) == output.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of bytes as 43-char b64url (no padding). input is b64url bytes. Assert sha256(input) == sha256.

ttl.description: WORKER ONLY. Clients never implement or hardcode a lifetime; they show file.expires. size = Content-Length - 28 (plaintext bytes, decimal). ttl_min = min(1440, floor(14,400,000,000 / size)); size 0 -> 1440. Content-Length > MAX_FILE + 28 -> 413 and ttl_min null. Content-Length < 28 (no room for nonce and tag) -> 400, size and ttl_min null. Assert ttl_min and status for each content_length.

upload_request.description: One full POST /v1/file request (blob from blob.cases "hello"). Content-Length = body length; PA-File-SHA256 = b64url SHA-256 of the body; PA-Send-ID = 22-char b64url of 16 random bytes, the same on each retry of one send; PA-Sig over the PA-FILE1 POST string. Assert every header from the body and the fields, that PA-Sig verifies with sign_pub, and that the body opens with key to plaintext.
